Subject: Office hours — evening cohort capacity split & waitlist

Hi all,

Thanks for your interest in the evening office hours cohort on Nov 24. We're planning a 90-minute group demo + Q&A focused on inference performance and cost controls. A few logistics I wanted to share and get confirmation on: 

- Capacity: we have 6 firm seats for the main room. If demand exceeds 6, we'll open a second concurrent breakout room and run a capacity-split (two smaller sessions).
- Prioritization: for now we'll prioritize active PoC customers and folks who requested live benchmarking. Others will be offered waitlist seats.
- Timezones: session listed at 5:00 PM PT / 8:00 PM ET; if a majority requests an earlier slot we can offer a second earlier cohort.

Please reply with: 1) Confirm attend or waitlist preference, 2) If you need an earlier slot (state timezone), and 3) any items you'd like covered in the live demo.

Attached: redwood_office_hours_agenda_v2.pdf (PDF, 18 KB) and I'll follow up with the invite (.ics) once roster is set.

Best,
